description: The information layer, as an artifact rather than a number someone typed. Every packaged command in clawock.cli.PACKAGED_UTILITIES appears exactly once: inside a layer, or in `excluded` with the reason it is not information collection. The README tables in both languages are checked against these counts by tests/test_information_layer_taxonomy.py; the taxonomy previously survived #429 moving every module it counted, because nothing tied the two together.
inclusion_rule: A module is in the information layer if a scheduled run consumes its output as input to a decision: it either acquires data from outside the repository, or computes a derived measure over data that was. Modules that publish, record, gate or replay a decision that has already been made are excluded and listed with their reason, so the boundary is visible instead of implied.
